window.MTC.ready.then(() => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150))).then(() => { const s = document.getElementById('scene'); s.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'center' }); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)).then(() => { const deg = (el) => { const m = new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(el).transform); return Math.round(Math.atan2(m.b, m.a) * 1800 / Math.PI) / 10; }; for (const a of s.getAnimations({ subtree: true })) { a.pause(); const n = a.animationName; if (n === 'foot-tap') a.currentTime = 324; if (n === 'hand-tilt') a.currentTime = 0; } return new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))).then(() => JSON.stringify({ leg: deg(s.querySelector('.scene__leg')), hand: deg(s.querySelector('.scene__hand')) })); }); })
